name: Water Purification / RO
description: Water purifiers, RO, UV, mineral add-back, smart monitoring and subscription models, compared with Indian adoption (TDS, borewell vs municipal, reject-water concerns, AMC culture). First deep-dive vertical, for CLARYN.

indiaFitNotes.title: Service and installation network
indiaFitNotes.detail: Indian RO buyers expect quick installation and AMC service in their own town. Plan technician coverage, spare filters and response times before promising nationwide delivery.

indiaFitNotes.title: Installation conditions
indiaFitNotes.detail: Many homes have low line pressure, intermittent supply and overhead tanks. Confirm the product works at low pressure (or with a booster pump) and through power cuts if it is electric.

indiaFitNotes.title: Reject-water messaging
indiaFitNotes.detail: Concern about RO wastewater is rising. Claims such as 'zero wastage' need evidence you can show, and a reuse-water story helps.

indiaFitNotes.title: Health and taste claims
indiaFitNotes.detail: Alkaline, hydrogen and 'mineral' benefit claims can attract regulatory and consumer scrutiny. Keep claims factual and test-backed.

features.label: Under-sink / tankless RO
features.description: Hidden under the counter, often tankless with a fast flow.
features.presenceNote: Most Indian units are wall-mounted or countertop with a storage tank; tankless under-sink is uncommon.

features.label: Countertop RO (no plumbing)
features.presenceNote: Some brands sell countertop or portable RO.

features.label: UV-C self-cleaning bottles
features.presenceNote: UV stages inside purifiers are common, but portable UV-C bottles are rare.

features.label: Alkaline / mineral add-back
features.presenceNote: Mineral cartridges are widespread in Indian RO.

features.label: Smart / IoT water-quality monitoring
features.description: TDS sensing, app alerts, filter-life tracking.
features.presenceNote: A few connected models; not mainstream.

features.label: Filter subscription / auto-refill
features.description: App-driven filter delivery or pay-per-month service.
features.presenceNote: AMC contracts are common, but app-driven auto-refill subscriptions are rare.

features.label: Hydrogen-rich water
features.presenceNote: A few imports, little local supply.

features.label: Zero / low reject-water design
features.presenceNote: Several brands claim water saving; claims vary in substance.

features.label: Compact, minimalist design
features.presenceNote: Compact models exist; design-led positioning is limited.

features.label: Instant-hot / temperature dispensing
features.description: Hot, ambient and cold water from one unit.
features.presenceNote: Available from several brands at higher price points.

features.label: Whole-house filtration
features.description: Sediment and carbon filtration at the inlet.
features.presenceNote: Mostly sold through plumbers and projects, not branded retail.

waterProfiles.label: Treated municipal supply, TDS under ~300
waterProfiles.typicalSource: Many municipal supplies in large cities
waterProfiles.recommended: UV + UF is often enough; RO is optional (with a TDS controller to keep minerals).
waterProfiles.notes: Over-purifying low-TDS water strips minerals and wastes water; RO is a harder sell here.

waterProfiles.label: Mixed supply, TDS ~300 to 600
waterProfiles.recommended: RO with a TDS controller; mineral add-back helps taste.
waterProfiles.notes: The core RO market in many cities.

waterProfiles.label: Borewell, TDS above ~600 and hard water
waterProfiles.recommended: RO is essential, with sediment pre-filtration and often softening for hardness.
waterProfiles.notes: Membranes wear faster, reject water is highest and weak-pump units struggle. Reject-water reuse and filter subscriptions matter most here.
